Name: JP's Nature - Grass and Flowers
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center]﻿[/center][font=Georgia][size=6][b][i][color=#00ff00][u][center]Grass and Flowers[/center][/u][/color][/i][/b][/size][/font][font=Georgia]
[color=#00ffff][size=5][b][i]Add beautiful flowers to the grass growing on your farm and in the valley, giving the whole town a more beautiful landscape to look at.[/i][/b][/size][/color]

[/font][font=Georgia][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][i]You can add pretty flowers to the grass growing everywhere (which you can remove with the scythe).[/i][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][i]There are up to 10 different colors to choose from, and you can select whether the flowers will be one, two or three different colors at a time.[/i][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][i]Each season the flowers will have a slightly different design to give more variety over time.[/i][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][i]You can also change the color of the grass! You can choose a different color per season. There are several color options, some are very crazy.[/i][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][i]If you want more, you can also change the color of the rain or even replace it with some objects that will fall as rain.[/i][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][i][color=#f4f4f4]Special options [u][b]for low-end devices[/b][/u] such as [/color][color=#ff7700]more transparent grass[/color][color=#f4f4f4] or an option to [/color][color=#ff7700]keep raindrops from falling during storms[/color][color=#f4f4f4], which will slightly increase game performance at certain stages.[/color][/i][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][i]Configure, enable or disable the options as you wish.[/i][/size][/color][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia]


[size=6][color=#ffff00][b][i][u]Mod Options:[/u][/i][/b][/color][color=#ff7700] 
[/color][/size][size=4][b]I recommend using the Mod: "[/b][/size][size=4][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][color=#f4f4f4]". To read what each option does from this menu.

[/color][/b][/size][/font][font=Georgia][color=#ff0000][size=6][b][i][u]In theory, the option to add flowers should be compatible with any mod that changes the grass design. [/u][/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]

Downloads.Description: ♥♥♥ Unzip and move to the Mods folder of the game. If you like it don't forget to hit the 'Endorse' button at the top of this page. ♥♥♥
